msg_1_subject: Hub-and-Spoke Exec Workshop — proposed arrival windows & calendar holds
msg_1_body:
Hi Samantha —

Thanks again for taking the time yesterday. Per our conversation, we want to lock the core exec workshop days for Orlix and propose the following hub-and-spoke schedule so we can align travel and rooming: 

- Core workshop (onsite, Palo Alto HQ): Nov 15–16, 2026 — Exec sessions 09:00–16:30 PT
- Remote cross-site deep dive (APAC hub): Nov 17, 2026 — 02:00–06:00 PT / 18:00–22:00 SGT
- Optional working session (virtual): Nov 18, 2026 — flexible 09:00–12:00 PT

Can you confirm whether the Nov 15–16 core dates work for your execs? If so, we’ll issue calendar holds for the 15–18 timeframe and share a draft agenda and invite letter for visa purposes.

Action items for Orlix: 
- Confirm headcount for Nov 15–16 (target: 6–8 execs)
- Confirm any dietary or AV constraints for onsite rooms
- Confirm whether Orlix would like a private pre-brief for the CIO on Nov 14 morning (we can hold a 45-min slot)

I’ve attached a rough agenda and a template invite letter for visas we can customize.

Best,
Mina
Director, Customer Programs
Redwood Inference

Attachments: hub-spoke-draft-agenda-v1.pdf, visa-invite-letter-Orlix.docx
msg_2_subject: Re: Hub-and-Spoke Exec Workshop — proposed arrival windows & calendar holds
msg_2_body:
Hi Mina —

Appreciate the clear windows. Nov 15–16 for the core onsite looks good on our side — we’re confirming a couple of CIO conflicts but expect to have final headcount by Friday (Oct 30). 

Quick notes from my side: 
- Headcount likely 7 (CIO, Head of Prod, Head of Infra, Head of Security, two PMs, one Architect).
- We definitely want the private pre-brief Nov 14 morning — please hold a 45-min slot.
- AV note: the CIO prefers a BYOM presentation laptop (we’ll bring a Surface) and HDMI only — can the room provide HDMI + adapter?

We reviewed the agenda — looks good. Please customize the invite letter for the five non-US execs (we will send passport details next week).

Thanks — we’ll reply with headcount by Friday.

— Sam
Director, Global Programs
Orlix Systems
